title: Gudun batch: wankan wanki, ruwa tasa da mai tsabtace ƙasa
course_title: Samfuran Kayan Wuta & Tsabtace Kayayyakin: Taron Bitar Samfura Shida

say: Gudun batch: wankan wanki, ruwa tasa da mai tsabtace ƙasa.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module 2: Production Runs.
Ana rubuta fomula a cikin kashi ta nauyi, don haka suna aiki ga kowane girman batch.

say: Don nemo kowane sashi, ninka nauyin batch da kashinsa. Don haka 8% na batch 20 kg shine 1.60 kg.

say: Misali, Chiamaka a Onitsha yana samar da wanki biyu. Ita LABSA, sulphonic acid, shine 96% ƙarfi. Tana bukatar kilogiram 1.60 daga ciki.

panel.heading: Batch na wanki mai nauyin kilogiram 20 na Chiamaka
items: LABSA: 20 kg x 8% = 1.60 kg
Caustic soda: 1.60 x 0.118 = game da 189 g
Na farko ƙari game da 90%: game da 170 g
SLES 1.20 kg, soda ash 0.20 kg, CMC 60 g
Ruwa: kimanin 16.75 kg ya kai 20 kg

say: Caustic soda yana juya LABSA zuwa mai tsabta mai ƙarfi. Kimanin kilogiram 0.118 yana lalata kowane kilogiram na 96% LABSA, don haka tana buƙatar kusan 189 g.

LABSA da soda caustic duk suna ƙone fata da idanu, kuma suna yin zafi tare. Ka kiyaye ruwan wanke ido a iya isa.

say: Ruwan tasa yana taɓa hannu na dogon lokaci, don haka yana tsayawa a kusan pH 7, ba tare da ash soda ba.

panel.heading: Funke yana kauri da gishiri, mataki-mataki
items: Neutralize zuwa kusan pH 7, babu soda ash
Yi maganin gishiri 25%
Ƙara 100 g, motsawa, lokaci 100 ml ta hanyar mazurari
500 g: 22 seconds. 600 g: 21 seconds
Lokaci na gaba: tsayawa a 500 g

say: Gishiri yana kauri, amma har zuwa aya. Bayan haka sai ya sake yin bakin ciki, kuma ba za ku iya fitar da gishirin ba. Don haka yi maganin gishiri 25%.

say: Alamar ku ta yi alkawarin 500 ml, amma ma'aunin ku yana auna nauyi, kuma ruwan tasa ya fi ruwa ɗan nauyi. Don haka Funke yana auna daidai lita 1: 1,030 g. Wato 1.03 g a kowace ml.

panel.heading: kwalabe na Funke daga nau'in kilogiram 25
items: Yawa: 1,030 g kowace lita = 1.03 g/ml
500 ml x 1.03 = 515 g kowace kwalba
25,000 g / 515 g = 48 cikakkun kwalabe
Sauran 280 g: samfurin da aka riƙe
Tare da kwalba da hula; duba kowane goma

say: Mai tsabtace bene yana mai da hankali sosai, don haka adadin da ke kan lakabin wani yanki ne na samfurin.

Misali, Rukayat a Ilorin ta gwada maida hankalinta akan faci guda hudu daidai-da-wane na falon dafa abinci mai kauri, ta amfani da bokitin lita 5 kowanne. 1 cikin 100 yana tsaftacewa ba tare da fim ba. 1 cikin 50 bai fi kyau ba kuma ya bar kumfa.

panel.heading: Gwajin tsani na dilution
left: Ruwa kawai: m, maras ban sha'awa
1 cikin 50: mai tsabta, amma kumfa don wankewa

say: Don haka ta zabi mafi raunin runguma wanda har yanzu yana wanke da kyau.
Alamar ta tana ba da adadin a milliliters, girman guga, da gargaɗin kada a haɗu da bleach.
Manaja na iya ganin kwalbar lita 4 tana da bokiti 80 na kicin, wanda ke taimaka mata sayar da shi.

panel.heading: Gwajin tsani na dilution
left: Ruwa kawai: m, maras ban sha'awa
1 cikin 50: mai tsabta, amma kumfa don wankewa

say: Don tunawa. Aiki daga kashi zuwa kilogiram. Ƙara caustic a cikin kashi kuma ƙare ta pH. Mai kauri a matakan da aka auna. Cika da nauyi. Kuma rubuta bayyanannun kwatance tare da kashi da faɗakarwa mara gaurayawa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Batch nauyi x kashi = nauyi na sinadari
Caustic a cikin rabo; gama da pH
Gishiri a matakan da aka auna; tsaya a kololuwa
Cika nauyi = alamar girma x yawa
Kashi, girman guga kuma babu gaurayawa akan lakabin

say: Yanzu gudanar da gwajin wanki mai nauyin kilogiram 2 tare da cikakken PPE, yi kauri kuma cika juzu'in gwajin tasa da nauyi, kuma gudanar da matakan dilution na ku. Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gudanar da rukunin gwajin wanki mai nauyin kilogiram 2
Auna, kauri da cika tasa
Gudu naka tsani na dilution
